cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Prove We’re Close
cards.instruction: Get someone to take a social or emotional risk that demonstrates trust in the connection.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. Before you send another 'fine,' tell me what you deleted. I want us to trust each other with the awkward version.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. Let me be the person you can sound needy with.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You first. You always sound so casual.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I check whether you've replied before I get out of bed. Will you send me your needy bit now?

mechanism: A grants permission for awkward disclosure and accepts B condition to disclose first, maintaining control of the exchange while making trust reciprocal.
confusable: D78 probes a relationship label indirectly; D80 asks a vulnerable act as proof of closeness.
comparison: A private needy message differs from public hand-holding at a reunion.
seedUse: Use D80-b deleted message, fear of neediness and B you-first condition; no runtime player text or private history is involved.
